title: Kissed with Dill Middle-Eastern Peppers Roasted Pepper Muhammara
description: A flavorful and crunchy Middle-Eastern dip, kissed with dill and served in a mason jar.
instructions: Place the red bell peppers and jalapeno on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and roast for 30 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool. Once cool enough to handle, peel off the skin, remove the seeds, and chop the flesh.
In a food processor, combine the chopped peppers, panko breadcrumbs, garlic, dill, lemon juice, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Process until coarsely chopped.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the muhammara to a mason jar, cover with plastic wrap or aluminum foil, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the muhammara chilled or at room temperature with pita bread, crackers, or vegetables.
